race.comment: TAPPY'S STAR (6) gets the nod after a sound first-up fifth at Sunshine Coast, where she was in the firing line before tiring late and was beaten just over two lengths despite being unwanted in the market. She comes through provincial company into a more suitable assignment and can give this a shake. REPEAT OFFENDER (8) is the main danger on recent form, improving into third at Grafton over 1700m after a solid Port Macquarie fourth, with the slight query being the return to 1500m where she is still unplaced. Can feature. BLUE SKIES AHEAD (9) was plain first-up, but being forced wide gives her a little more room to improve second-up. ELLOFABY (14) honest mare with back-to-back Gatton seconds and excuses last time. Include.
